text:
incident-bot: 🚨 Pager fired: `cuda.alloc.fail` on pool=cluster-dense-rtx16 rate=12/min threshold=5 — affected hosts: rtx16-03..rtx16-10
pagerduty: :rotating_light: PD alert #INC-45921 triggered (sev=high). Escalation policy: oncall-engineering -> alex.
alex: ack'd. I'm on it.
sam: seeing spike on the GPU alloc errors graph, vmem used ~98% on several nodes, fragmentation high.
maya: curious if this is a sudden workload change or a regression in allocator. Any recent model rollouts?
alex: no model rollout in the last 2h per deploy-bot. Checking recent traffic and batching config.
alex: tailing logs from rtx16-05, cropped:```
2026-03-15T09:03:10Z ERROR cuda: alloc failed: wanted=1.2G available=0.8G
2026-03-15T09:03:11Z WARN runtime: kv-cache evictions increased 3x
2026-03-15T09:03:12Z ERROR cublas: cudnn out of memory while init workspace
```
sam: that sequence screams fragmentation + large workspace req. Might be a peak with long sequences. Querying recent request lengths.
alex: quick sql: `select avg(seq_len), p99(seq_len) from requests where pool='dense-rtx-16' and ts > now()-10m` -> avg=410, p99=1900. Big tail.
maya: ok, mitigation options: 1) drain a few nodes from scheduling to reduce multi-tenancy pressure 2) temporarily route heavy requests to lower-memory model variants 3) bump Dedicated pool capacity (if spare) 4) restart runtimes to defragment (risky).
alex: starting with least-risky: cordon two noisy nodes and evict best-effort jobs. Running:`infractl node cordon rtx16-05 && infractl node cordon rtx16-06`
system: infractl: cordon accepted for rtx16-05, rtx16-06. Evicting preemptible tasks...
alex: evictions kicked off. Triggering autoscaler request for +2 nodes as fallback: `autoscaler-bot request-scale --pool dense-rtx-16 --add 2 --reason "alloc failures spike"`
autoscaler-bot: scale request queued, attempting provisioning in us-west-2c. ETA ~4m.
sam: after cordon/evict, error rate dropped to ~4/min but still above baseline. Noticed a handful of customer requests hitting p99 latency > 3s.
alex: collecting affected customer ids: `cust-514, cust-198, cust-331` — likely clients running long-context inference. Opening incident ticket with customer-impact note.
maya: can we fast-fail long sequences to a smaller model or cutoff? We have a dynamic fallback route in routing-config. Alex can you toggle to reduce max_seq for dense pool?
alex: flipping routing-config: set `max_seq=1024` for pool dense-rtx-16 (was 4096) — applying.
system: routing-config: change applied. Active connections will continue, new requests subject to rule.
sam: metrics: alloc fails down to 1/min, latency p99 back to ~1.1s. Autoscaler still provisioning.
autoscaler-bot: +2 nodes provisioned rtx16-11, rtx16-12 and joined pool.
alex: good. I'll keep the pool cordoned until we confirm stable. I'll also create a short postmortem stub and handoff to next oncall in 25m.
maya: note for postmortem: include sequence length distribution, why kv-cache eviction rate spiked, and whether batching parameters caused large workspace allocation.
alex: adding notes. Customer-impact summary for support: "brief spike caused elevated latencies for a small subset (3 customers) for ~7 minutes. We mitigated by cordoning noisy nodes, applying max_seq fallback, and adding +2 capacity. No data exposure. Apology + credits recommended."
zara: pinging in as next oncall (starting 09:40). I'll take over monitoring and followup. Any checklists for me?
alex: handoff: 1) keep cordon on rtx16-05/06 until end of day unless we see stable metrics for 2h; 2) confirm routing-config reverted once deploy safe; 3) validate no regressions in batching config; 4) follow up with infra to schedule a controlled runtime restart on two impacted hosts for defrag during low-traffic window. Links: incident ticket https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-45921, metrics dashboard https://metrics.redwood.ai/d/allocs/dense-rtx-16
zara: ack. I'll run checks and add follow-up tasks. Thanks for the runbook notes.
alex: closing my active participation. If it reblows, PD will escalate to infra-sre.
pagerduty: Incident #INC-45921 acknowledged by alex at 2026-03-15T09:04:10Z. Next escalation in 12m if unacknowledged by secondary.
zara: adding action items: - postmortem draft by EOD - validate fallback routing in staging - test autoscaler warm pool for noisy workloads - recommend default max_seq for dense pools in docs
maya: +1 on warm pools. Also propose an alert to catch p99 seq_len > 1500 sustained for 5m.
sam: noted. I'll create the alert PR.
zara: handing responsibility officially to me. Marking thread as oncall-handoff.
incident-bot: thread closed by zara (oncall handoff) at 2026-03-15T09:13:50Z.
